description.sr: Spisak studenata na poseti udruženju 23.10.2026, kako ga je nastavnik zapisao istog dana, redom. Poseta je održana posle četvrtog časa: prototipi su u udruženju dalje razrađivani, dokumentovani i testirani sa korisnicima. Fotografije iz udruženja snimljene su u istom nizu kao i fotografije prototipa, posle njih, i prenete su sa telefona 24.10.2026.
description.en: The list of students on the association visit of 23 October 2026, as the teacher wrote it the same day, in order. The visit followed the fourth class: at the association the prototypes were developed further, documented and tested with users. The photographs from the association were taken in the same sequence as the prototype photographs, after them, and were transferred from the phone on 24 October 2026.

summary.sr: Druga poseta udruženju, u petak 23.10.2026, istog dana kad je održan četvrti čas. Sedamnaest studenata je ponelo prototipe u udruženje i tamo ih razrađivalo, dokumentovalo i testiralo sa korisnicima. Šesnaest imena sa ovog spiska stoji i u spisku radova četvrtog časa; jedno ne stoji — to je osamnaesto zavedeno prisustvo tog dana, bez zavedenog rada. Od trideset jednog snimljenog kadra objavljeno je dvadeset osam; tri kadra na kojima se prepoznaju lica korisnika udruženja ostaju van serviranja.
summary.en: The second association visit, on Friday 23 October 2026, the same day the fourth class was held. Seventeen students brought their prototypes to the association and there developed, documented and tested them with users. Sixteen names on this list also stand in the fourth class’s list of works; one does not — that is the eighteenth recorded attendance of the day, without a recorded work. Of thirty-one frames taken, twenty-eight are published; three frames in which the faces of association users are recognizable stay out of serving.

title.en: The object rarely stands on its own

seen.sr: Na većini kadrova predmet drže dve ruke, ili ga jedna ruka pridržava dok druga istražuje. Pertlani poklopac se podiže obema rukama, kutija sa čepovima se naginje dok se igra.
seen.en: In most frames two hands hold the object, or one hand steadies it while the other explores. The laced lid is lifted with both hands, the box with corks is tilted while being played.

next.sr: U sledećem probanju proveriti da li predmet ostaje stabilan na stolu dok ga koristi jedna ruka. Zabeležiti klizanje, potrebu za pridržavanjem i razliku između stola i krila.
next.en: In the next trial check whether the object stays stable on the table while one hand uses it. Record slipping, the need for steadying, and the difference between table and lap.

seen.sr: Četiri različita rada traže isti pokret: umetanje dela u otvor ili provlačenje pertle kroz rupicu. Na kadrovima se vidi hvat sa dva prsta i prilaz otvoru pod uglom.
seen.en: Four different works ask for the same movement: inserting a piece into an opening or threading a lace through an eyelet. The frames show a two-finger grip and an angled approach to the opening.

next.sr: Uporediti veličine otvora između radova i zabeležiti koji otvor prima deo iz prvog pokušaja. Fotografije ne potvrđuju uspeh, samo položaj ruke.
next.en: Compare opening sizes across the works and record which opening accepts the piece on the first attempt. The photographs do not establish success, only hand position.

title.sr: Brojevi i tačke uz isti predmet
title.en: Numbers and dots on the same object

seen.sr: Komplet sa brojevima koristi se u više kadrova: kockice sa ciframa idu u polja, a pločice sa tačkama stoje uz njih kao drugi zapis iste količine.
seen.en: The number set appears in several frames: digit cubes go into the fields while dotted tiles lie beside them as a second notation of the same quantity.

next.sr: Proveriti da li se cifra i tačke koriste naizmenično ili odvojeno, i da li je potrebno uputstvo pre prve upotrebe.
next.en: Check whether digits and dots are used interchangeably or separately, and whether an instruction is needed before first use.

title.sr: Digitalni rad traži sto, miša i mirnu podlogu
title.en: The digital work needs a table, a mouse and a steady surface

seen.sr: Jedini digitalni rad posete koristi se sa laptopa na stolu, uz miša; u kadrovima je ruka na mišu, a ne pred kamerom.
seen.en: The only digital work of the visit is used from a laptop on a table, with a mouse; in the frames a hand is on the mouse, not in front of the camera.

next.sr: Probati i upravljanje pokretom ruke pred kamerom na lakšem nivou i zabeležiti razliku. Samo sopstveni interfejs rada kaže da je na teškom nivou kamera manje precizna.
next.en: Also try hand-movement control in front of the camera at an easier level and record the difference. The work’s own interface states that the camera is less precise at the hard level.
